name: open-design
description: Chat-driven UI prototyping with Tweaks/Comment/Edit/Draw tools

scripts.cf:provision: (npx wrangler whoami >/dev/null 2>&1 || npx wrangler login) && if grep -q 'TODO_FILL_AFTER_CREATE' apps/api/wrangler.toml; then DB_ID=$(npx wrangler d1 create open-design 2>&1 | awk -F'"' '/database_id/ {print $2}') && perl -i -pe "s|TODO_FILL_AFTER_CREATE|$DB_ID|" apps/api/wrangler.toml; else echo '✓ D1 already provisioned in wrangler.toml — skipping create'; fi && (npx wrangler r2 bucket create open-design-blobs 2>&1 || true) && npm run db:migrate:remote --workspace=@open-design/api
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy --workspace=@open-design/api && npm run vendor --workspace=@open-design/web && VITE_VENDOR_RUNTIME=true npm run build --workspace=@open-design/web && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name=open-design-web
